item.title: Pendulums and Orbits
item.description: In this technical post, we derive the relationship between the period of an orbit and the radius of the orbit using a simple pendulum. Then we look at how to compute azimuth and elevation angles to a satellite using orbital parameters.

item.title: Interesting Physics and Engineering Videos
item.description: There are more than a handful of fascinating physics and engineering related videos on YouTube. I’m sharing a list of my favorites here. It also helps me keep track of these videos over time. I will try to update regularly.
